questions.stem: Which of the following statements about wound healing is true

options.label: A
options.text: Type 1 collagen predominates in the early stage of wound healing.

options.label: B
options.text: Collagen undergoes remodelling at the end of first week

options.label: C
options.text: Type III collagen is weaker than type I collagen

options.label: D
options.text: Tensile strength of the wound is associated with its elastin content
